record.one_liner: Cloud observability and security platform for metrics, logs, APM traces, dashboards and monitors, with a public REST API.
record.auth_notes: Requests use an API key (DD-API-KEY header) and, for read endpoints, an application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY). Personal access tokens are recommended for new integrations and MCP clients. OAuth2 authorization code flow with PKCE exists for partner integrations published through the Datadog partner program.
record.access_notes: critic: access self_serve_trial -> self_serve_free. Pricing/FAQ (search snippet from datadoghq.com/pricing) says after the trial you can 'move to the Free tier' with up to five Basic hosts and 1-day metric retention at no cost; the pricing page also lists free tiers (LLM Observability Free tier, no credit card required). API and application keys are created in org settings and work on any org. Also a 14-day trial with no card required.
record.api_notes: Documented REST API reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest covering most product objects (per the API reference and MCP docs). Regional sites use different hostnames.
record.blocker_notes: Credentials are self-serve in the product. Using OAuth for third-party distribution would need partner publication review, but API key and PAT access does not.

evidence.quote: Requests that read data require full access and also require an application key.
